scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n core,adapter-eventemitter,adapter-eventtarget,cloud,server,web,demo "npm run dev -w @ida/core" "npm run dev -w @ida/adapter-eventemitter" "npm run dev -w @ida/adapter-eventtarget" "npm run dev -w @ida/cloud" "npm run dev -w @ida/server" "npm run dev -w @ida/viewer" "npm run dev -w @ida/demo"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ida/core && npm run build -w @ida/adapter-eventemitter -w @ida/adapter-eventtarget -w @ida/cloud
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ida/server && npm run build -w @ida/viewer
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-eventemitter && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-eventtarget && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cloud && tsc --noEmit -p apps/viewer && tsc --noEmit -p apps/demo && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server
